clues: This town sits on the edge of a high flat land in the north of Zambia. It looks down on a wide river valley below.
British rulers liked the cool air up on the high flat land. Most folks lived down in the hot valley below them.
British rulers chose this town to run the district long ago. It still runs the same district for the state today.
A short drive from this town lies the biggest tea farm in Zambia. It is a huge farm where green tea leaves grow.
Three falls lie close to this small town in the north. One falls west of town, and one more falls far to the north east.
